tooltip.mech_arsenal.autocannon: Use your fire key while piloting; rounds come from the walker's magazine first, then your inventory.
tooltip.mech_arsenal.autocannon_mount: Two-block-tall rotating turret with a 1.8-block barrel. Tracks the pilot's aim while piloting.
tooltip.mech_arsenal.stationary_cannon: One block wide, three long and two high. Load 120 mm shells into a nearby magazine; right-click to fire when not piloting.
tooltip.mech_arsenal.ammo_magazine: Nine slots for autocannon rounds and 120 mm shells. Install near the walker's core; weapons draw their matching ammunition first.
message.mech_arsenal.no_walker: Could not identify the walker from its control block.
message.mech_arsenal.no_mount: No mounted cannon was found in this walker.
message.mech_arsenal.no_rounds: No autocannon rounds in the magazine or your inventory.
message.mech_arsenal.no_heavy_shells: No 120 mm shells in the magazine or your inventory.
message.mech_arsenal.no_mounted_ammo: No matching ammunition for the walker's mounted weapons.
hud.mech_arsenal.title: TACTICAL LINK
